title: One-Way Riders with Creek Kids Club Care: Seat Share under the Student Transportation Services Courtesy Permit Fee Schedule
content:
A Student Transportation Services courtesy rider who rides one way is billed a share of the seat: the period rate times the billed share of the permit period is multiplied by the riding share.

**The care enrollment read.** The rider's Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program enrollment read is the one for the school year in status active. A withdrawn, dismissed or ended enrollment of the same year is not read; the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program allows only one open enrollment per student and school year.

| That active Creek Kids Club enrollment | Riding share |
|---|---|
| at the campus the rider is transported to, on Creek Kids Club After-School Care (5 Days) or Creek Kids Club Before-School Care (5 Days) | 0.60 |
| at that campus, on Creek Kids Club After-School Care (2 Days) or Creek Kids Club After-School Care (3 Days) | 0.80 |
| any other case: another plan, another campus, or no active enrollment | one |

## Cases (hypothetical riders)

| Rider's Creek Kids Club enrollment for the school year | Riding share |
|---|---|
| active, After-School Care (5 Days), at the campus the bus serves | 0.60 |
| active, After-School Care (3 Days), at that campus | 0.80 |
| active, Before & After-School Care (5 Days), at that campus | one |
| active, After-School Care (5 Days), at a different campus | one |
| withdrawn earlier in the year, no active enrollment | one |
